name: Biffa Award Partnership Grants Scheme (natural environment theme)
summary: Large grants of £250,000 to £1,000,000 for constituted not-for-profits near Biffa sites, with a natural environment theme for protecting and restoring species, habitats and natural processes. A built environment theme runs alongside; the 2026 round is closed.

eligibility.rule: Has a fully constituted charitable or not-for-profit status and no share capital
Not a local authority, hospice, hospital, care/day-care/rehab/activity/wellness centre, allotment, school or college
Project site is within 25 miles of a significant Biffa operation or active landfill site
Project site is within 10 miles of a licensed landfill site
Not a village hall, community centre or church
Has planning permission and required work licences before submitting the Expression of Interest
For Natural Environment projects on land it does not own, has a signed 25-year landowner access agreement

eligibility.quote: The organisation must be a fully constituted, charitable or not-for-profit organisation with no share capital.

Unfortunately, local authorities, hospices, hospitals, day-care centres, rehabilitation units, residential care facilities, allotment sites, activity centres, wellness centres and schools/colleges are not eligible to make an application through the Biffa Award scheme.
The project site must be within 25 miles of a significant Biffa Operation or active Biffa Landfill Site
The project site must ALSO be within 10 miles of a licenced landfill site
Village halls, community centres and churches are excluded from making an application to the Partnership Grants Scheme.
All shortfall funding must be secured
Planning permission and or licences to undertake any work must have been granted prior to the submission of an Expression of Interest

A fully signed landowner agreement, giving permission to access the site for maintenance, surveying and monitoring for at least 25 years post completion of the project must be in in place for Natural Environment projects, if the applicant does not own the land
